div.div: مُبْسِقٌ A she-camel excerning the first milk, or biestings, into her udder before bringing forth: (As, S, K: [see 4:] and see also بَسُوقٌ:) pl. مَبَاسِيقُ. (S, K.) And A girl that is a بِكْر [see 4] having milk flowing into her breast. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
